description: This file contains implementation of timeout and timer management functions within the libwebsockets library, including setting and handling timeouts for WebSocket connections, scheduling timer callbacks, and managing connection validity checks.

methods.name: void __lws_wsi_remove_from_sul(struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Removes scheduled timeout, hrtimer, and validity callbacks from a WebSocket instance.

methods.name: void lws_sul_hrtimer_cb(lws_sorted_usec_list_t * sul)
methods.description: Callback invoked when high-resolution timer expires, triggers protocol callback or closes the websocket.

methods.name: void __lws_set_timer_usecs(struct lws * wsi,lws_usec_t us)
methods.description: Sets a high-resolution timer for a websocket instance.

methods.name: void lws_set_timer_usecs(struct lws * wsi,lws_usec_t usecs)
methods.description: Public interface to set a timer in microseconds.

methods.name: void lws_sul_wsitimeout_cb(lws_sorted_usec_list_t * sul)
methods.description: Callback invoked when a websocket connection times out, handling cleanup and logging.

methods.name: void __lws_set_timeout(struct lws * wsi,enum pending_timeout reason,int secs)
methods.description: Internal function to schedule a timeout for a websocket.

methods.name: void lws_set_timeout(struct lws * wsi,enum pending_timeout reason,int secs)
methods.description: Public API to set a timeout with specified reason and seconds.

methods.name: void lws_set_timeout_us(struct lws * wsi,enum pending_timeout reason,lws_usec_t us)
methods.description: Set a precise timeout in microseconds.

methods.name: void lws_validity_cb(lws_sorted_usec_list_t * sul)
methods.description: Callback to handle validity checking and scheduling for a websocket.

methods.name: void _lws_validity_confirmed_role(struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Confirms validity of a websocket from role level, resetting timers.

methods.name: void lws_validity_confirmed(struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Confirms the WebSocket's validity, typically after a successful keepalive or pong.

ctags.name: __lws_set_timeout
ctags.pattern: /^__lws_set_timeout(struct lws *wsi, enum pending_timeout reason, int secs)$/

ctags.name: lws_set_timeout
ctags.pattern: /^lws_set_timeout(struct lws *wsi, enum pending_timeout reason, int secs)$/

ctags.name: lws_set_timeout_us
ctags.pattern: /^lws_set_timeout_us(struct lws *wsi, enum pending_timeout reason, lws_usec_t us)$/
